name: chatuse
description: macOS and Ubuntu/X11 computer use: screenshots, accessibility, OCR, mouse, keyboard and window control.

interface.longDescription: Local computer use for macOS 13+ and Ubuntu GNOME on Xorg. No per-app approval layer; requires desktop permissions and an unlocked session. Wayland is not supported.
defaultPrompt: Use Chatuse to inspect and operate apps on my desktop.
